gameList.title: Educational Games
gameList.meta: EduFunHub's interactive learning games: adventures, quizzes, class duels, arcade and board games for kindergarten to senior high.

upcoming.intro: Classroom multiplayer games we are building now. All are played together on the projector and students' devices.

monsterCafe.title: Monster Café / Pizza Frenzy
monsterCafe.concept: Students are chefs in a monster restaurant.
gameplay: Monster customers place food orders; every ingredient is the answer to a quiz question.
Answer correctly to earn an ingredient, such as cheese, bread or sauce.
Assemble the ingredients into a burger or pizza before the monster gets angry (patience timer).
Watch out for burnt orders and ingredient-stealing rats, and use the pie power-up to blur another student's screen for 2 seconds.
monsterCafe.fun: Frantic, funny cartoon food and a fast pace with no downtime.

saboteurLab.title: Saboteur Lab / Impostor Protocol
saboteurLab.concept: A team of school scientists repairs a leaking lab reactor.
gameplay: Most students are Scientists: answering quizzes repairs reactor modules.
1–2 random students are secret Saboteurs: they answer wrong on purpose or plant viruses in modules.
Every 3 minutes an emergency vote on the projector asks the class to find the saboteur.
saboteurLab.fun: Social intrigue and friendly accusations get even quiet students talking.

bossDefense.title: Dungeon Crawl / Boss Defense
bossDefense.concept: The whole class fights a multi-level dungeon monster.
gameplay: Students pick a role when joining: Attacker (big damage), Healer (restores class HP) or Tank (absorbs boss attacks).
Every quiz answer generates Mana/Energy to cast the role's skills.
The monster attacks periodically; if Healers answer too late, team HP drops.
A Quick Time Event on the main screen: every student must answer within 5 seconds to cancel the boss's ultimate attack.
bossDefense.fun: Quizzes become a team battle. Students who are less confident academically still matter as support or healer.

pixelPainter.title: Pixel Painter / Turf War
pixelPainter.concept: A battle to paint a giant canvas between 2–4 colour teams.
gameplay: The main screen is a giant black-and-white pixel art grid.
Every correct answer gives paint ammo in the team colour.
Students tap screen coordinates to shoot paint at rival areas.
The team with the largest colour share when time runs out wins.
pixelPainter.fun: Highly visual, contributions show up instantly on the projector, competitive yet relaxed.

tetrisQuiz.title: Tetris Quiz / Block Battle
tetrisQuiz.inspiration: Tetris mechanics · spatial logic + academic quiz
tetrisQuiz.concept: Stack Tetris blocks while answering quizzes. Comes with three game modes.
gameplay: Battle Royale mode (Tetris 99 style): every student plays their own board with a short quiz beside it. Correct answers earn a straight I-piece or send grey garbage lines to rivals until their board overflows (KO).
Wrong or slow answers make blocks fall 2× faster for 5 seconds and leave an opening for rivals to attack.
The projector shows 30–50 live mini-boards, with garbage lines visibly flying from one student to another.
Word & Formula mode: blocks carry letters, numbers or formula parts. Placing them to form a correct word (Indonesian/English) or a correct sum (e.g. 4 + 5) blasts the row for bonus combo points.

Co-op Fortress mode: the whole class builds one fortress wall together. Answer quizzes to earn a turn dropping a patch block while monsters keep pounding the wall; the neater the stacking, the stronger the defence.
tetrisQuiz.fun: The thrill of striking back and surviving to be the last one standing; Word & Formula trains the brain right on the board, and Co-op is low-toxicity, great for primary classes that need teamwork.

osiPingPong.title: Ping Pong Network / OSI Layer Match
osiPingPong.concept: A ping pong duel where you return the ball by naming the right OSI layer.
gameplay: A device or term appears on screen: Router, Switch, Hub, UTP cable, HTTP, MAC address, IP address.
Tap the matching layer: Layer 1 (Physical), Layer 2 (Data Link), Layer 3 (Network) or Layer 7 (Application).
A correct answer bounces the ball back to your opponent; a wrong one concedes a goal.
osiPingPong.fun: Four big buttons and fast reactions turn memorising the 7 OSI layers into a match instead of a rigid lesson.

tap.body: Tap a piece below and it fills the first empty slot (1, 2, 3, …). Tapped the wrong one? Tap it in its slot to send it back.

test.title: 3. Press TEST
test.body: The LAN tester lights the pins one by one. Correct = all green and you jump straight to the next module. Wrong = the LEDs stop red at the first wrong pin.

score.title: 4. Fast = big score
score.body: Every correct order scores 100 points, plus a speed bonus of up to +100 under 5 seconds. Three correct in a row = combo and a random power-up.

power.body: Send Tangle or Freeze to slow a rival down, or raise a Shield to stay safe. With no target picked, the attack goes to the leader.

win.title: 6. Win the track
win.body: Your avatar moves along the fibre track with every correct module. Race: first to finish the module goal wins. Time Attack: highest score when time runs out. The podium shows the top 3.

howTo.title: How to play
howTo.demoItemBox: A correct answer opens a random Item Box
howTo.demoBalance: Places 1–3 never get Missile or Lightning. The further back, the better the odds.
howTo.demoShield: A Shield blocks 1 Missile/Banana and ignores Lightning for 8 seconds.
howTo.demoBanana: Drop a Banana behind you. Whoever runs over it stops for 3 seconds.
howTo.demoTicker: Budi fires a Missile at Rani!

join.title: 1. Teacher opens the arena, students join
join.body: The teacher opens the Arena on the projector or Smart TV, picks a subject and number of questions, then shows the PIN and QR code. Students scan the QR code or type the PIN on their phone.

answer.title: 2. Answer on your phone
answer.body: Every student gets the same question with 4 choices. Tap an answer before time runs out. Your answer locks once tapped.

speed.title: 3. Right = Nitro, wrong = stutter
speed.body: Base speed is 50 km/h. A correct answer fires Nitro at 120 km/h; the faster you answer, the longer it lasts. A wrong answer makes the engine stutter at 30 km/h for 2 seconds.

items.title: 4. Grab an Item Box
items.body: Every correct answer gives 1 random item (hold up to 2). Tap the item button on your phone any time to use it.

attack.title: 5. Attack or defend
attack.body: The Missile chases first place, Lightning shrinks and slows every rival, the Banana Peel traps racers behind you, and the Shield protects your kart.

win.title: 6. Finish 3 laps
win.body: The projector shows the circuit, live ranking and race news. The first to finish 3 laps wins. Every student earns points and the podium appears at the end.
